ns2:course.label: Instrumental Characterization
ns2:course.description: Lecture course covers the fundamentals of instrumental characterization including: nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, potentiometry, voltammetry, atomic and molecular spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, and gas and liquid chromatography. Prerequisite: CHEM 440; or credit or concurrent registration in CHEM 442; or consent of the instructor.
